$comment: Portable MCP server definitions, translated per host on install: Claude → ~/.claude.json (user scope), Cursor → ~/.cursor/mcp.json, Codex → [mcp_servers.*] tables in the managed block of ~/.codex/config.toml. Keys starting with $ are ignored (comments/examples). Use `hosts` to limit a server to specific hosts. Put secrets in each machine's environment — NEVER inline here.
